summary: 707 Cayman Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, reporting a 12-for-1 share consolidation effective July 14, 2026, to maintain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule (Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2)). The consolidation reduced Class A shares from 7,660,968 to ~638,414 and Class B from 390,300 to 32,535, with fractional shares rounded up. No price, premium, or deal terms were involved; this is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
